releaseGates.passCriterion: Legal owner, trading name, contact address and moms presentation documented and reviewed.
Signed service definition covers each offer, entity eligibility, transaction limits, trial, cancellation, exclusions and filing responsibility.
Responsible staff, required Swedish AML registration/supervision and Skatteverket ombud arrangements and maximum weekly onboarding capacity recorded.
Tenant isolation, authentication, access control, encrypted transport, audit trail and restore test verified; no unresolved critical defects.
Valid test enquiry persists once in production CRM; invalid enquiry does not create lead; responsible staff receives test.
All ad Final URLs replaced with verified owned HTTPS production pages; zero blank or placeholder Final URLs remain.
Fresh/rejected sessions make zero GA/Ads network requests; separate consent choices and withdrawal pass recorded tests.
Correct GA4 property receives expected consented test events once; zero sensitive financial or contact data in payloads; duplicate primary conversion sources removed.
Organisation-owned Analytics and Ads IDs, billing owner, SEK and Europe/Stockholm settings recorded with access roles.
Actual delivery and onboarding cost estimate supports a numeric allowable CAC; Keyword Planner export dated and retained.
Owner approves specific media ceiling, test dates and offers; approval record retained and approvedSpendLimitSek updated.
Google policy review completed for final ads and destinations; remains distinct from owner approval.
Ads Editor import has zero unresolved errors; every campaign, group, positive keyword and ad remains Paused until approved activation.

Dated GBP/SEK observation and quote direction verified if conversion is used; final SEK prices, moms treatment, trial and scope reviewed. No GBP reference is presented as confirmed Swedish checkout price.

pricing.note: The website illustrates SEK 2645/month and SEK 7935/year-end from the GBP 200/600 reference. These are proposals, not approved Swedish prices. Final SEK amounts and VAT remain unset.
